title: Fire hits ice cream storage facility under construction in Batangas

blocks.text: A fire engulfed a nearly completed four-storey building being constructed for ice cream manufacturer Degic Foods Corp. in Barangay Bulihan in Malvar, Batangas on Sunday afternoon, causing an estimated P111 million in damage, the Bureau of Fire Protection said.
